remarks: Discover your dream retreat in this beautifully updated 3 bedroom, 2-bath home, perfect for modern living. Situated on a private, level acre with serene wooded views, this home gives the peace you crave with the convenience you need. Step inside to enjoy open, versatile spaces, hardwood floors, and abundant natural light. Cozy up in the living room with a charming fireplace and bay window, or host friends in the dining room with glass doors opening to a spacious new Trex deck and slate patio -perfect and for grilling, entertaining, or relaxing under the stars. The remodeled kitchen shines with sleek Samsung appliances, blending style and function effortlessly. Upstairs, you'll find three well-sized bedrooms and a freshly updated bathroom. The lower level boasts a bright family room and an additional full bath, while the basement has room for a home gym or extra storage. This smart home features central air, modern upgrades, and proximity to everything Norwalk has! Your perfect balance of nature, privacy, and convenience awaits-don't miss out! See Special Features Sheet for complete list of all the new features in this home. Visit FinalOffer.com to track activity or get more information about this property. Enter the property address and sign up for real-time alerts, price changes, and more. Best and final offers are due by Tuesday 12/3 at 5PM.
